name: Long-term restaurant and optional precision nutrition / meal-planning direction
status: Canonical product direction only; deferred implementation, no activation authority
coreDecision: One food business / restaurant brand, one menu, one recipe and production system; simple restaurant ordering by default with optional structured nutrition and meal planning.

defaultRestaurant: Good food, photography, clear descriptions, price, portion/package size, allergens, pickup/delivery, cart and checkout when independently ready.
No required height, weight, calorie goal, macros, calculator or dieting language.
Flagship frozen gnocchi, rotating meals, meal kits, prepared food, family portions and seasonal products remain attractive without planning.
optionalPlanner: Opt-in height, weight, age, formula-required sex, activity, goal, dietary preferences/restrictions and household profiles.
Adult deficit, maintenance or surplus goals; sensible desired rate where appropriate without needless complexity.
Progressive simple, detailed nutrition and planner views; calculator easy to ignore.

canonicalRecipe: Ingredient grams; liquids grams/mL as appropriate; preparation method; finished and serving yields; portion weight; cooking-loss adjustments.
Calories, protein, carbohydrates, fat, fiber, sodium and micronutrients only where sufficiently reliable; ingredients and allergens.
Cost, nutrition/cost per gram, package/SKU relationship and nutrition per package.
Exact shared recipe versions for ordinary orders and planned meals; separate fitness recipes only for real culinary/product reasons.
portionRules: Derive grams from recipe nutrition, calorie target, protein/fiber strategy, overall daily plan and reasonable serving constraints.
Preserve satiety and real-food adequacy; no absurdly tiny portions.
5000 g batch and 340/280/420 g portions are illustrative, never hardcoded.
Suggested portions must map to supported production/package/serving offers; suggestions do not create order authority.
household: Future one account with multiple household profiles, individual portions, needs, preferences, allergens and goals; one family meal with suggested servings per person.
Child/youth planning requires separate conservative age-appropriate guidance; never apply adult weight-loss logic or simplistic deficit/surplus dieting to minors.
energyEstimation: Future evidence-based resting energy and approximate total daily expenditure estimates with target calorie ranges; use estimated maintenance language.
Never use endomorph/mesomorph/ectomorph, nationality, race or ethnicity as metabolic inputs.
No formula or exact metabolism claim established here.
adaptiveSystem: Optional future weight, adherence, average planned-meal calorie intake and appropriate activity observations.
Calculate -> portion -> eat -> observe trend -> recalibrate -> repeat.
Compare predicted changes against rolling trends with sufficient observation windows; do not react to isolated daily weigh-ins.
Unexpected loss under an estimated maintenance plan may suggest higher maintenance; unexpected gain may suggest adjustment, without automatic certainty.
weeklyPlanning: Build My Week may use calorie/protein targets, preferences, allergens, budget, household size, goal, favorites and product availability.
Support lunches, dinners, 5 or 10 meals/week, workweek, family dinners or custom selections; never require buying every meal from us.
differentiation: Known recipes and measured portions support decisions before purchase and consumption, followed by food arriving measured; not merely another after-the-fact calorie logger.
flagship: The same Signature Gnocchi product has normal image/description/package/price/cooking/order presentation and optional serving grams, nutrients, meal-kit nutrition, plan-based portions, protein/vegetable pairings and daily-target effect.
founderInsight: River uses a small digital food scale to weigh ingredients, finished yield and portions, cook creatively with nutrition visibility, manage intake/body weight intentionally, reduce random/processed/eating-out food and make nutrition repeatable. Capture and planning must be simple enough for River to use.
currentPriority: Resolve account-page analytics/privacy and real-browser prerequisites

futureSlices.scope: Flagship gnocchi product architecture and recipe-capture model
Optional nutrition calculator and customer meal-planning architecture

numberingRule: Candidate numbering may adapt only if existing canonical repository architecture requires it; no implementation slice is begun or closed by this direction.
launchPhases: 1: normal restaurant, flagship products and transparent nutrition facts
acceptanceCriteria: Normal ordering succeeds without nutrition onboarding or fitness framing.
Ordinary and structured presentations use the same canonical food/version data.
Nutrition depth is optional, realistic portions preserve satiety, and child planning remains separate.
Unsupported metabolic inputs are excluded; estimates and data reliability remain explicit.
Existing identity/admin work retains priority; calculator does not delay an otherwise ready restaurant launch.
No deferred domain types are prematurely implemented.
boundary: Documentation revision and staging only for the five FOOD-vision files. No technical implementation, production action, Cloudflare contact, deployment, commit or push. Separate owner authorization required for commit.

hardRequirements.flagshipPositioning: Premium chef-driven frozen gnocchi is a core brand-recognition, freezer-friendly, scalable, satisfying, nutrition-aware restaurant-quality direct-to-consumer flagship and eventual commercial/retail candidate.
productForms: Standalone packaged frozen gnocchi sold by weight/portion
Complete kits: gnocchi, sauce, protein, vegetables, finish/garnish and preparation/plating instructions; separate packaging where useful
Prepared gnocchi meals designed as complete meals, not merely gnocchi and sauce
hardRequirements.initialSkuStrategy: 2–3 permanent/core flagship SKUs plus 1 rotating/seasonal SKU, optional kit variants, individual and potential family formats; final recipes/flavors determined by River prototypes.
hardRequirements.recipePossibilities: Classic potato, ricotta-forward, sweet-potato/vegetable, seasonal vegetable, higher-protein or legume-enhanced are possibilities, never finalized recipes.
hardRequirements.proteinStrategy: Contextual 25–40+ g protein per complete entrée design range; essential amino-acid adequacy, quality, complementary sources and BCAAs within sufficient complete protein; never sacrifice culinary quality to inflate numbers.
hardRequirements.proteinSources: Lentils, beans, chickpeas, peas, edamame, tofu, tempeh, eggs, dairy, cheese, ricotta, grain + legume combinations and other legally/operationally suitable foods.
hardRequirements.nutritionQuality: Reliable calories, protein, carbohydrates/quality/complex carbohydrates, added/simple sugars, fiber, total/saturated fat, sodium, iodine, potassium, calcium, iron, magnesium, zinc, folate, B vitamins, A/C/D/E/K; vegetable diversity, density, satiety, tolerance and useful glycemic characteristics. Balanced day/week, no medical-treatment or every-meal-100%-of-every-nutrient claims.
hardRequirements.saltIodine: Flavor/texture/finishing salt is separate from intentional iodine coverage through appropriate foods or iodized salt; no inherently healthier sea/pink salt claim.
hardRequirements.domainSeparation: Product, production recipe, reusable component, controlled recipe version, package/SKU, yield-derived nutrition profile, cost profile and customer preparation instructions remain distinct; one recipe may support bags, individual/family kits, prepared meals and sauce/seasonal combinations.
hardRequirements.ownerCapture: Cook -> capture ingredients/weights/method/live adjustments -> normalize -> measure yield -> establish portions -> calculate nutrition/ingredient/packaging costs -> labor/time -> freeze -> thaw/cook/reheat -> customer instructions -> presentation -> revise/version. River remains chef; recipes need not be finalized before cooking.
hardRequirements.freezerTesting: Freeze method/stability, sticking/clumping, freezer burn, package integrity, stored texture, boiling/pan finishing, sauce stability, vegetable/protein texture, frozen/thawed preparation, error tolerance, safe realistic storage duration and labels; no unsupported shelf-life claims.
hardRequirements.componentPortions: Separate gnocchi, sauce, protein, vegetable and garnish/finish weights, complete weight, calories/protein/fiber, serving yield and category; individual, larger-appetite, family or standalone frozen. Exact weights are prototype/economics-driven.
hardRequirements.presentation: Photos, plating, finishing sauce, herb oil/herbs, grated/crumbled finish, toasted texture, allergen-appropriate seeds/nuts, storage-compatible crispy components, garnish/color/sequence and QR preparation video. Open -> cook/reheat simply -> finish -> plate. Michelin-level is internal aspiration only, no recognition claim.
hardRequirements.economics: Per-SKU ingredient/component, packaging/labels, payment/delivery allocations, labor, waste/yield loss, freezer/storage, total COGS, price, gross-profit dollars and gross-margin percentage; explicit allocations avoid double counting.
hardRequirements.marginRule: Never shrink portions merely for margin; improve sourcing, batches, process, yield, waste, packaging, pricing, mix and inventory. Customers leave fed.
hardRequirements.inventory: Distinguish made-to-order and frozen inventory; future on-hand quantity, batch, frozen date, availability, package count, reserved/sold quantity and storage state. No fields implemented now.
hardRequirements.growth: Intended initial local DTC within applicable Texas cottage-food rules, subject to verified recipe/channel readiness; potential licensed commercial production, larger batches, distribution, retail freezer, lawful operational shipping/wholesale and packaged-brand expansion; no current approval inferred.
hardRequirements.storefront: Flagship prominence/story/photos/package/price/availability/nutrition/protein-fiber/ingredients-allergens/instructions/plating/video/cart/pickup-delivery/reorder/seasonal releases are future presentation, not implemented UI.
